scripts.dev:emulated: concurrently -k -n emu,web "npm run emulators" "VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true npm run dev -w web"
scripts.emulators: node scripts/ensure-emulator-secrets.mjs && npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-pass-tracker --only auth,functions,firestore
scripts.test:emulated: node scripts/ensure-emulator-secrets.mjs && npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-pass-tracker --only auth,functions,firestore "vitest run --project emulated"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w functions
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
